comment: The overtone amplitudes are one over the harmonic number, and the output is divided by the sum of the amplitudes actually sounding (overtone.cpp:249), which is what keeps the level steady as harmonics are switched. A cable in the MASK jack overrides the eight panel switches entirely (overtone.cpp:156); the lamps then follow the CV rather than the switches.
